text:
Arlington, TX - There's a new sheriff in town. The Texas Rangers are happy to announce that SS Vance Law is the newest member of the their 1982 team that once again has World Series aspirations. After their draft plans rapidly changed when potential target Vance Law was pulled out of the rookie draft, team owner and GM frazzman80 took to the SMail lines and reached out to Law's former GM big_dowg to get negotiations underway to bring Law to Texas. "Vance Law brings order to our infield going forward and we are very pleased to have the opportunity to have such a versatile player as a Ranger," said frazzman80. "We predict that in his tenure with the club that he will play SS, 2B, 3B and OF for us and maybe even some 1B in the future. His strong bat will fit anywhere in the lineup and he's got some solid pop for a middle infielder. We're excited as his versatility will mean we can draft for some potential positional needs in the next few drafts."



Law has played sparingly in his previous 2 seasons and had a disastrous 1981 slashing a meager .134 .157 .164 in his 113 PAs, but thinks that the change of ballpark and being surrounded by potential HOFers in the clubhouse will help him find his groove at the plate.



This reporter has reached out to big_dowg to confirm the trade.
